name: Big West Cross Country Championships
where: Riverside, CA · host UC Riverside · Ag/Ops course
headline: Big West Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Cal Baptist won the men's title with 28 points to Utah Valley's 33 and Cal Poly's 91, led by individual champion Pedro Marin in 23:07.8. Utah Valley took the women's title with 44 points to Cal Baptist's 63 and Cal Poly's 77, while Cal Poly's Tatiana Cornejo won the individual race in 18:55.4, ahead of Utah Valley's Caren Kipsirat (18:58.3).
